reminders.toggle_subtitle: Every day at the times you pick, with a new tip each time

0.title: Where did your money go?
0.body: Track today's money before you regret it tomorrow and can't tell where it went.

1.title: Just one minute
1.body: Log today's spending in a minute and save yourself the headache at the end of the month.

2.title: Every pound counts
2.body: Small expenses are what empty your salary. Log them before you forget.

3.title: Future you says thanks
3.body: People who log today don't get surprised at the end of the month.

4.title: You're the boss here
4.body: Your money won't manage itself. Open Flowsy and add what you spent.

5.title: Coffee? Ride? Food?
5.body: Everything you spent today deserves a line in Flowsy.

6.title: Don't leave it for tomorrow
6.body: By tomorrow you'll forget half of it. Log it now.

7.title: A small step every day
7.body: A quick daily log means full control over your money.

8.title: Your wallets miss you
8.body: Check your balance and add today's spending so the numbers stay right.

9.title: Know where it goes
9.body: Log every day and you'll see exactly what's eating your money.

10.title: Your goals need a plan
10.body: Every pound you track today gets you closer to what you want.

11.title: No spending without tracking
11.body: Add what you spent today, even if it was small.

12.title: Be the smart one
12.body: People who are good with money track it every day. Start now.

13.title: Stay in charge
13.body: When you know what you spent, you decide what you spend next. Log it.
